tools.name: working_seed
tools.description: Seed tenant/session-scoped working memory with bounded TTL and evidence provenance.

tools.name: working_query
tools.description: List live working-memory items in an explicit authenticated subject scope, newest first. limit keeps only the newest `limit` items after the scope filter; kinds keeps only items of those kinds. With neither, every live item of the scope is returned.

limit.description: Return only the newest `limit` items after the scope filter.

kinds.description: Return only items whose kind is in this list.

tools.name: working_promote
tools.description: Promote one working item through the regression-backed promotion gate.

tools.name: working_expire
tools.description: Expire due working-memory items in an explicit authenticated subject scope.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Append verbatim evidence to the content-addressed ledger. created=true only when this call inserted a live row; idempotent=true only when that live row was already present. A blocked erased replay or a deferred write sets both to false. tenant_id must not be empty.

tools.name: ingest
tools.description: Run the ingestion pipeline with provenance verification and optional object externalization.

tools.name: assert_fact
tools.description: Upsert a typed assertion with evidence provenance.

tools.name: source_sync
tools.description: Compile committed Markdown/git source-of-truth assertion blocks into evidence-backed memory.

tools.name: relation
tools.description: Add a temporal relation edge for graph retrieval. Without source_evidence_cids a self-attested evidence record is minted so the edge is still retrievable, and the result carries a warning: such an edge earns no independent corroboration and is graded at the lowest visible trust tier.

tools.name: preference
tools.description: Record an explicit or inferred preference with precedence rules.

tools.name: schedule_intention
tools.description: Schedule a data-only prospective-memory intention backed by originating evidence. An optional session-scoped idempotency_key replays the original creation acknowledgement; use list_intentions for current state.

tools.name: update_intention
tools.description: Reschedule or replace the data-only action for an authenticated subject intention.

tools.name: cancel_intention
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled prospective-memory intention as its owning user or agent.

tools.name: evaluate_intentions
tools.description: Evaluate due prospective-memory intentions from an authenticated scheduler context.

tools.name: list_intentions
tools.description: List prospective-memory intentions owned by the authenticated subject.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Fast hybrid retrieval with trust filtering, provenance, confidence, and abstention. Trust tiers are numeric and lower is MORE trusted (0 = direct user, 5 = untrusted external). min_trust_tier and max_trust_tier both name the least-trusted tier still admitted, and max_trust_tier is the one applied when both are given, so a contradictory pair (min above max) is refused rather than silently collapsed. session_id (honoured only with a valid signed session_token for that session, refused otherwise) ranks that session's live working memory together with long-term memory in the one list, and a working item and the ledger record it cites come back as one hit. token_budget fits the hits to fewer tokens and is clamped, not refused, above the policy budget of 4096. lean leaves out the explain block and the per-hit diagnostics. Every hit's metadata says its memory_type and created_at.

session_id.description: Rank this session's live working memory together with long-term memory. Honoured only on a call carrying a valid signed session_token for the same session; refused otherwise.

token_budget.description: Fit the hits to this many tokens. A value above the policy budget (4096) is clamped to it, not refused.

lean.description: Leave out the explain block and the per-hit diagnostics (standing, standing_observability, reality_monitoring, retrieved_text, activation, privacy, lifecycle).

tools.name: deep_search
tools.description: Expanded retrieval path with graph channel enabled when graph data exists. Takes session_id, token_budget and lean exactly as search does.

session_id.description: Rank this session's live working memory together with long-term memory. Honoured only on a call carrying a valid signed session_token for the same session; refused otherwise.

token_budget.description: Fit the hits to this many tokens. A value above the policy budget (4096) is clamped to it, not refused.

lean.description: Leave out the explain block and the per-hit diagnostics (standing, standing_observability, reality_monitoring, retrieved_text, activation, privacy, lifecycle).

tools.name: get
tools.description: Fetch one CURRENTLY VALID memory record by id or cid from the tenant export surface. History is deliberately out of scope: a superseded, retracted or erased record is reported as not found. The ledger still retains a superseded assertion (status=superseded, with valid_to set), and its earlier value is read with graph_as_of at a timestamp inside its validity window.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Return retrieval stages, channels, provenance, confidence, and immutable rails.

tools.name: propose
tools.description: Write a candidate fact into an isolated proposal branch for later confirmation.

tools.name: confirm
tools.description: Confirm a proposed branch or candidate id by merging it into main.

tools.name: correct
tools.description: Record an authoritative correction and upsert the superseding assertion.

tools.name: supersede
tools.description: Supersede an existing assertion with a newer assertion value.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Erase evidence content on EVERY branch holding the cid and propagate retraction or provenance trimming. Reports branches_erased; pass all_branches=false to erase only the named branch.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export a caller-scoped tenant disclosure view with omissions and redactions reported.

tools.name: residency_policy
tools.description: Inspect configured data/runtime residency enforcement and transfer allowlists.

tools.name: branch
tools.description: Create a branch from an existing branch. The name must be non-empty, must not be the reserved name 'main', and must not be path-like.

tools.name: merge
tools.description: Merge a branch into another branch through the engine contract.

tools.name: discard
tools.description: Discard a non-main branch and its candidate memories.

tools.name: profile_add
tools.description: Add a typed user-model entry.

tools.name: profile_context
tools.description: Return scope-matched user-model context.

tools.name: profile_get_relevant
tools.description: Blueprint alias for returning relevant user-profile context.

tools.name: profile_record_explicit
tools.description: Blueprint alias for recording an explicit user preference.

tools.name: profile_propose_inference
tools.description: Blueprint alias for proposing an inferred user preference.

tools.name: profile_correct
tools.description: Record an explicit profile correction. The entry named by id is superseded by the corrected statement and no longer appears in profile_context; weaker inferred entries that differ are superseded too. id must name an active entry in this tenant/user scope. The correction keeps that entry's scope unless context is given, and is an explicit preference unless it replaces an instruction or an identity, which stay what they are. Authority is the caller's role and trust tier (a signed session sets both): correcting a hard instruction is a policy write.

tools.name: profile_retire
tools.description: Take a profile entry back: it stops being active and no longer appears in profile_context. The record is kept, marked retracted. An unknown id, or one from another tenant or user, is an error. Authority is the caller's role and trust tier (a signed session sets both): taking an entry back is a destructive write, which needs the operator or consolidator role, and a hard instruction is a policy write.

tools.name: profile_record_mistake
tools.description: Record a neutral user-slip episode and promote scoped support only after repeated similar events.

tools.name: profile_retire_support_strategy
tools.description: Retire a scoped support strategy so it no longer appears in profile context.

tools.name: prefetch
tools.description: Warm retrieval contexts through the anticipatory predictability gate.

tools.name: graph_neighbors
tools.description: Run tenant- and branch-scoped graph PPR over relation seeds. k is the number of hits and must be at least 1.

tools.name: graph_query
tools.description: Graph neighbour query over relation seeds, limited to edges whose both endpoints lie within hops edges of a seed. hops and k must each be at least 1.

tools.name: graph_timeline
tools.description: Return assertion and relation events involving an entity.

tools.name: graph_as_of
tools.description: Return bitemporal assertions for a subject/predicate at a timestamp.

tools.name: trajectory_log
tools.description: Persist a trajectory for procedural/corrective learning. outcome must be 'success' or 'failure'.

tools.name: trajectory_record
tools.description: Blueprint alias for persisting a trajectory. outcome must be 'success' or 'failure'.

tools.name: trajectory_attribute
tools.description: Attribute a logged failure trajectory.

tools.name: lesson_induce
tools.description: Induce a corrective lesson from a failure attribution.

tools.name: lesson_propose
tools.description: Blueprint alias for proposing a lesson from a trajectory.

tools.name: procedure_induce
tools.description: Induce a procedure from a corrective lesson.

tools.name: procedure_propose
tools.description: Blueprint alias for proposing a procedure from a lesson.

tools.name: lesson_promote
tools.description: Promote a lesson through protected regression cases. Requires at least one regression case, like working_promote.

tools.name: procedure_validate
tools.description: Mark an induced procedure as validated for the isolated parametric tier.

tools.name: procedure_promote
tools.description: Promote a validated procedure into the active procedural tier.

tools.name: procedure_search
tools.description: Search procedures by name, body, signature, tenant, and status.

tools.name: procedure_rollback
tools.description: Mark a procedure as rolled back without deleting history.

tools.name: lesson_search
tools.description: Search lessons by failure signature, content, tenant, and status.

tools.name: outcome_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a logged trajectory outcome or counterfactual before/after counts.

tools.name: parametric_propose
tools.description: Create an isolated shadow parametric artifact from active lessons/procedures.

tools.name: parametric_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a shadow parametric artifact against persisted protected gate evidence.

tools.name: parametric_rollback
tools.description: Roll back a persisted isolated parametric artifact with protected-suite evidence.
